description: Return the full USD-based exchange-rate snapshot for one date: `rates` maps every supported currency to units per 1 USD. Use when the user wants a multi-currency table in USD (for example "today's rates"). Use `get_rates_by_base` for a non-USD base, `convert` for one pair or amount, and `get_history` for a time series. Omitting `date` returns the latest available snapshot, which is not necessarily today. Returns `{ base: "USD", date, rates }`; a date with no snapshot is a 404. Requires a signed-in connection; each successful call bills 1 API request.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to the latest available date.

name: get_rates
title: Exchange rates (USD base)
